title: Harold Malmgren: NHI track the frontier of human innovation

tellings.quote: Why did a presidential adviser named Harold Melmgrren who worked [music] directly with JFK, LBJ, Nixon, and Ford and who was briefed on UFOs, why did [music] he tell me that this is how the nonhuman intelligences operate by tracking the frontier of human innovation?

plain: Non-human intelligences, beings said to be behind UFOs, operate by tracking the frontier of human innovation, according to a presidential adviser named Harold Malmgren, who worked directly with Kennedy, Johnson, Nixon and Ford and says he was briefed on UFOs. Michels says Malmgren told him this himself. If true, it would mean these beings watch wherever human science is pushing forward.
